name: framer-moveable-thumbnails
blurb: Image carousel with draggable thumbnail strip for navigation and selection.
description: Carousel with a main display image and draggable thumbnail strip below. Click or drag thumbnails to navigate. Main image expands to full aspect ratio; unselected thumbnails collapse. Spring-based snap animation.
use_when: Photo galleries or product showcases where users need both overview and detail views.
avoid_when: Limited screen space; requires room for both main image and thumbnail strip.
a11y: Thumbnail drag and click handlers; no keyboard navigation exposed.
